title: The Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1982-04-12
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 Tagged. Transfer by Andrew F. 05/2011
source: AUD: 2x Nakamichi CM300's > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA-90's. Set up behind the stage, recorded from the rear-facing P.A. system. Taped by Joe Morrone.

ai_review.summary: Excellent behind‑stage audience recording with a crystal‑clear Birdsong mix; the show is praised as a nice performance.
ai_review.review: The audience tape captured from behind the stage is described as the best‑sounding version on the Archive, with a very clean mix dialed in by Birdsong. Reviewers also note that the concert itself was enjoyable, though no specific songs are highlighted.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review (4 stars) mentions both superb recording quality and a pleasant show; rating reflects strong audio with an overall decent performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Behind‑the‑stage audience tape, very good sound, mix dialed in by Birdsong, clear and well‑balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewers simply describe the show as nice.
